headline: Thanh Hau Nguyen debuts at 34th on ARC-AGI-2 with 54.72

sections.text: Thanh Hau Nguyen is new to the ARC-AGI-2 public board and entered at 34th with 54.72 points.
A debut at 34th puts the entry in the middle of the chase for medals. Public standings remain provisional, and medals are decided on the private board.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
